name: Agent Plan Card

semanticTypeCandidates.evidence: Multi-step agent plan with progress tracking
Sequential steps with current active and completed states

representativeVariants.name: Executing Plan

traits.header: brain icon + Agent 计划 + progress text

representativeVariants.childrenDigest: Header with progress + vertical timeline of steps with status indicators

representativeVariants.name: Completed Plan
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: Success header + completed step list with results

representativeVariants.name: Paused Plan
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: Paused header + step list with current step highlighted + resume action

representativeVariants.name: Step Failed
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: Error header + failed step with error message + retry skip actions

anatomy: Header: agent icon + plan title + overall progress indicator
Step timeline: vertical list of steps with connector lines
Step item: status icon + step name + optional description + optional result
Step status indicators: pending circle, active spinner, completed checkmark, failed x
Connector line: vertical, colored by step status
Action area: pause resume retry skip buttons
structurePatterns: Vertical timeline with connecting lines between steps
Current step has accent highlight and spinner
Completed steps have success checkmark and muted text
Failed steps have danger indicator and error text
Collapsible: header always visible, steps collapsible

usageHints.iosAdaptation: iOS custom cell with timeline view; Android LazyColumn with Canvas connector lines; Web CSS timeline with flexbox

keyInsightSeed: Vertical timeline stepper with per-step status tracking and connector lines
